stem: According to the graph, on average, during which period in their life are females taller than males of the same age?
correctAnswer: From approximately age 11 to age 13 (i.e. when they are 11 and 12 years old)
steps: Find where the female line is above the male line
The lines cross at approximately age 11 (female overtakes male) and age 13 (male overtakes female)
Females are taller than males between ages 11 and 13

rubric.description: Correct period identified: approximately ages 11 to 13 (or states age 11 and 12)
Correctly reads both crossover points from the graph to define the start and end of the period

rating.description: Correct interval (11 to 13) identified by reading both crossover points on the graph
Partially correct — identifies one crossover point or gives an approximate range close to 11-13
Incorrect period or misreads the graph (e.g. says females are always taller or gives wrong ages)
